name: simulate-contributions-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual contribution and employer-match phase extracted from simulatePlan. Five dedicated block-U members run in all four equivalence modes and discriminate employer deferral/catch-up routing and 415(c) match limits, ordered joint IRA compensation and owner ceilings, HSA spouse/survivor limits, Roth-basis and owned-IRA annual-pass re-entry, and exact positional duplicate-ID folds whose public balances remain logical aggregates.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary, nullish, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing one physical line, so the report's cold sub-line regions and focused helper/delegation tests must be read alongside this differential proof.
